Sandbox_MultiplayerFastForward_Speed1_to: Speed multiplier for the first fast-forward option. Whole numbers from 2 to 1000. Default: 5.
Sandbox_MultiplayerFastForward_Speed2_to: Speed multiplier for the second fast-forward option. Whole numbers from 2 to 1000. Default: 20.
Sandbox_MultiplayerFastForward_Speed3_to: Speed multiplier for the third fast-forward option. Whole numbers from 2 to 1000. Default: 40.
Sandbox_MultiplayerFastForward_MinimumPl: Fast forward requires this many online players. Counts all connected characters, including dead characters and admins. Pause and 1x remain available. Default: 1.
Sandbox_MultiplayerFastForward_AdminForc: Admins can hold Shift and select a speed to vote for everyone. Zombie protection, movement, the player minimum, and sleep acceleration still apply.
Sandbox_MultiplayerFastForward_ZombiePro: Pause everyone when a zombie is within any living player's protection radius during fast forward. Fast forward stays blocked until no nearby zombies remain. You can resume at 1x.
Sandbox_MultiplayerFastForward_ZombieRad: Distance in tiles, measured horizontally. Includes zombies on other floors and behind walls.
Sandbox_MultiplayerFastForward_Debug_too: Enable only for troubleshooting. Writes detailed mod logs.
